final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avgband, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage), s2 AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avgband) AS avgband, SUM(cnt) AS cnt FROM s1 GROUP BY lunarstage), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s2) SELECT s2.lunarstage, s2.avgband, s2.cnt, CAST(s2.cnt AS REAL) / NULLIF(s3.total, 0) FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.total IS NOT NULL
